title: Force Serving System Info
description: Forces RadioServingSystemAO's serving-system world state, re-publishing mp/ind/radio/sys_info. Every field is optional and applied only if present (_apply_force_sys_info patches field-by-field), so a caller can change just the RAT and leave domain/state untouched. Enum values mirror radio.sys_info.ind's, since this action feeds that indication directly. Backs taf_radio_AddRatChangeHandler testing -- the PA filters sys_info for an actual RAT transition before firing the handler, so forcing the same rat twice fires it only once.

slot.description: Which SIM slot's serving-system info to force.
